correctness.rationale: The number U of types not selected by an adaptive one-choice policy is a pure-death chain with exact death parameter q_(n,u)=1-binomial(n-u,d)/binomial(n,d), independent of tie breaking. The sum of geometric holding times from n to sqrt(n) concentrates around (n/d)log(n/sqrt(n))+n C_d, while the last sqrt(n) disappearances couple at o(n) error to independent exponential clocks, giving Pois(c_d e^-x) in the standard window. For disjoint tagged I,J, conditioning on avoiding I gives exactly the reduced n-a process and tagged factorial identity; inclusion-exclusion over J splits off already offered but unselected types. Mixed factorial moments yield independent Pois(e^-x),Pois((c_d-1)e^-x). Rare simultaneous draws of two still-unselected types permit the two independent pure-death limits across times, yielding joint Gumbel extrema. Integrating the difference of extrema gives F_D(z)=1/[1+(c_d-1)e^-z] for z>=0 with mass 1/c_d at zero. Exact finite tie probability convergence requires near-tie control; two independent continuous limiting maxima have zero tie probability, so ties come exactly from reversed final categories in the limit. d=1 yields identical policies. Independently computed seven sequential finite count-state distributions against labeled coupon-mask dynamics (n=5,d=2).
